subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text :
stimulus: Mother said to Nafi, "What are you doing now?" "I am doing my homework," said Nafi. "Why did not you do it yesterday?" asked mother. "I was ill yesterday," said Nafi. "Can I help you?" said mother. ইংরেজি দ্বিতীয় পত্র  101
guide_solution: Mother asked Nafi what he was doing then. Nafi replied that he was doing his homework. Mother again asked why he had not done it the previous day. Nafi said that he had been ill the previous day. Mother further asked him if she could help him.
